scope: Read-only implementation mapping addendum for the eleven GM04-238 gaps; no app/tests/scripts/central-register changes, builders or browsers.

additionalPrimarySource.qualification: Adjacent-year original service figure used only to explain the existing catalog attribution. It does not replace an original 1985 manual or establish blanket interchange.

caseBearingRetainerReconciliation.importantNumberingDifference: The 1986 service figure uses 24 at three positions. GM04-238 uses 24 at the two outer ends and separately identifies the output inner-end oil-shield sleeve as97. Thus equal callout24 is insufficient to merge identity names or assign original-year quantities.

existingCandidates.placementIntent: Small thin annulus just beyond the outboard bearing/oil-shield/case-end stack, on the input axis. Matches the region of the GM row24 input occurrence, not the distinct output inner-end row97.
Small thin annulus just beyond the output outboard bearing/oil-shield/case-end stack. Matches the region of the GM row24 output occurrence, not the distinct output inner-end row97.

caseBearingRetainerReconciliation.coordinateQualification: All coordinates/radii above are current code authoring values in metres, not measured factory data. Builder +X runs from engine toward outboard; physical handedness is corrected once at the boundary. No builder or scene was executed to infer final installed coordinates.
caseBearingRetainerReconciliation.recommendedIdPolicy: Keep tx-input-sleeve in trans-input and tx-output-sleeve in trans-output as compatibility IDs while reconciling the source identity; do not create another pair of retainer meshes in those same positions. If confirmed, use displayed names Input case-bearing retainer and Output case-bearing retainer with both the GM24 retainer attribution and the distinct 1986 service24 oil-shield-sleeve wording documented.
doNotConfuseWith: tx-input-retainer is the front input-bearing retainer/guide at authoringX .055/.089, source38/39 area; it is not this outer-end pair.
tx-output-retainer is the output bearing oil-shield retainer at authoringX .091, source29, not case-bearing retainer24.

row97FollowUp.figureLocation: Output inner/bearing end, opposite the current tx-output-sleeve location.

caseBearingRetainerReconciliation.furtherEvidence: Original-year case-bearing/sleeve installation or disassembly detail plus parts groups4.104 and4.422 application/quantity entries.
